messages:
sara_cs: FYI — NimbleBooks showing ~60% week-over-week API call drop after CTO left. Procurement mentioned a competitive pilot. Need a quick renewal risk triage. Key contacts: Lina (PM, still engaged). :warning:
metrics-bot: Weekly summary for nimblebooks — calls: 12,400 -> 4,900 (−60%), active seats: 28 -> 26, error rate 0.6% -> 0.8%, avg latency +5ms. Dashboard: https://redwood.metrics/nimblebooks/overview
dylan_csm: Got it. Did they name the competitor? Who's on the procurement thread? :thinking:
sara_cs: Procurement email mentions AtlasAI and Infrabot. Lina is on the procurement thread and has a sync tomorrow.
ashwin_se: Quick config check — no infra changes on our side, no quota alerts. Sounds adoption-related. Can someone pull top-10 endpoints by volume last 30d? I'll look for regressions.
metrics-bot: Query posted: SELECT endpoint, count(*) FROM requests WHERE account='nimblebooks' AND ts > now() - interval '30 days' GROUP BY endpoint ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10; Results attached (CSV).
maria_ops: Recommend immediate play: 1) 30m call with Lina + champion this week, 2) targeted enablement (sample prompts + runbook) + offer a 1-week Dedicated trial discount, 3) run churn-risk playbook and alert renewals. I'll ping renewals.
dylan_csm: sara — can you intro me to Lina and cc renewals? I'll propose Tue 10am PT. Need exec presence from AM.
sara_cs: Intro sent. Lina replied "available Tue morning" and looped in procurement. cc @kelly_renewals.
kelly_renewals: Thanks — I'll prepare a renewal-risk packet and a counter-proposal for a short pilot. Need success KPIs (engagement by power-users) — who can pull?
ashwin_se: I pulled power-user breakdown: user_a@nimblebooks (4k calls last 30d), user_b (1.2k), rest <500. Usage is concentrated in one team — if they change workflow we lose most volume.
dylan_csm: Proposed agenda for Tue: 1) show usage concentration and risk, 2) understand competitor scope, 3) propose enablement + pilot + small commercial tweak, 4) agree follow-up by EOW. @maria_ops @ashwin_se can you join?
maria_ops: I'll join for enablement pitch. @ashwin_se can prepare a quick migration/interop demo in case they ask about AtlasAI compatibility. sara to lead relationship, kelly to own the commercial counter-offer.
sara_cs: Sounds good. I'll own post-call notes and run an NPS pulse to Lina to capture immediate feedback.
metrics-bot: churn-detector flagged this thread as high-risk (score: 0.82). Automation: created case CS-8123 and notified renewals.
dylan_csm: Thanks team — after Tue call we'll decide if a deeper technical QBR is needed. :thumbsup:
